dn-ttc.name: TTC compact CNC lathes, 6″ and 8″ chucks — 45° slant bed
dn-ttc.summary: The TTC is Dener's compact slant-bed CNC lathe for shaft, flange and bushing work in series: a one-piece cast bed inclined at 45° that sheds chips into the conveyor, roller linear guides and C1 / C3 ballscrews coupled straight to the servo motors, a spindle on super-precision bearings and a 12-station servo turret that indexes in 0.2 s. The TTC-6 turns parts to Ø12″ (305 mm) × 17″ (433 mm) behind a 6″ hydraulic chuck at 6,000 rpm and takes 1.77″ (45 mm) bar; the TTC-8 has an 8″ chuck, 2.05″ (52 mm) bar and 4,500 rpm. With the optional BMT55 C-axis turret and its 12 live tools the same machine drills, taps and mills flats and slots in the one setup. Fanuc 0i-TF Plus control as standard, Mitsubishi M80 to order.

dn-tmc.name: TMC vertical machining centres, BBT40 — X 33.5 to 63″
dn-tmc.summary: Dener's TMC vertical machining centres mill, drill, bore and tap in one setup — pockets, contours, rigid tapping without a floating holder, and shapes drawn freehand in the Navi-Mill conversational software. The base, column and saddle are stress-relieved Meehanite castings laid out by finite-element analysis; the BBT40 spindle is direct-driven at 10,000 rpm (12,000 or 15,000 to order) with its own cooling; the 24-tool arm changer swaps tools in 1.3 s; double-nut C3 ballscrews and roller guides traverse at 1,417 in/min (36 m/min) and position to ±0.00016″ (±0.004 mm). Five sizes from the TMC 850 — 33.5 × 20.1 × 22″ (850 × 510 × 560 mm) over a 39 × 20″ table — to the TMC 1600 with 63 × 27.6 × 27.6″ (1,600 × 700 × 700 mm) and a 2,646 lb (1,200 kg) table load; the 1300 and 1600 have a 40 HP (30 kW) spindle motor.

dn-tdc.name: TDC double-column machining centres, BBT50 — X 82.7 to 161.4″
dn-tdc.summary: For parts too long, wide or heavy for a vertical machining centre — machine bases, moulds, plates, frames — the TDC double-column (gantry) machining centre carries the spindle on a saddle across a rigid cross rail between two columns, over a table that travels underneath. The BBT50 direct-drive spindle runs to 10,000 rpm on a 30 / 35 HP (22 / 26 kW) motor, with through-spindle coolant at 435 psi (30 bar); roller guides on all three axes. Three sizes: the TDC 2112 with 82.7 × 48 × 23.6″ (2,100 × 1,220 × 600 mm) travels, 55″ (1,400 mm) between the columns and a 24-tool changer, the TDC 3116 with 122 × 63 × 40″ and the TDC 4120 with 161 × 79.5 × 40″ (4,100 × 2,020 × 1,020 mm), a 157.5 × 71″ table for 26,455 lb (12,000 kg) and a 40-tool chain magazine.

dn-tgh.name: TGH-B 450 NC surface grinder, 17.7 × 35.4″ table
dn-tgh.summary: A precision surface grinder for flat, parallel and square faces on dies, moulds, plates, gauges and machine parts in hardened or soft steel and other materials. The table travels on scraped V and flat guideways with Turcite-B coating, driven hydraulically at 16 – 82 ft/min (5 – 25 m/min); the cross and vertical axes run on ballscrews and AC servo motors under a Mitsubishi NC with a 10″ touchscreen, so the operator keys in the stock to remove and the down feed — in 0.00004″ (0.001 mm) steps — and the cross feed are applied stroke by stroke. A 15.7 × 31.5″ (400 × 800 mm) electromagnetic chuck on a 17.7 × 35.4″ (450 × 900 mm) table, a Ø13.8″ (350 mm) wheel on a direct-drive spindle and 21.7″ (550 mm) under the wheel centre.
